description: The live catalogue capture contains one inquiry template. The next test uses that template to see whether a buyer can provide enough information for a provisional quote without a clarification round. The rehearsal uses fictional data. Commercial feedback has no classified signals and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury is unfunded and shows zero verified revenue. A paid catalogue order depends on an eligible inquiry, approved terms and administrative acceptance, with settlement verified separately. The intake test can proceed now. Verified approval of the exact terms would allow an eligible inquiry to advance to a quote.
